title: CLR/14/2009 of SMT. MEENA GAUR AND ORS Vs SMT. SAROJ BALA

paras.text:
CLR No.14/09
Honíble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
 None turns up for the revisionists
even in the revised call.
 Mr. Nagesh Agarwal, Advocate, is
however present for the respondent.
 Mr. Agarwal apprises that in
compliance of order dated 17.6.2016, he
had supplied the list of names of
proposed heirs of the sole respondent
(deceased), but no substitution
application has so far been moved.
 So, this revision, apart from being
abated, is also dismissed in non-prosecution.
 Interim order dated 11.11.2014 is
also vacated.
 LCR be sent back to the court
concerned.
